criteria.evidence: server/tests/error-collector-sentry.test.ts: integration test with a local node:http ingest endpoint; the driver is chosen by createErrorCollectorAdapterFromEnv(env) exactly as in src/server.ts and the transport is not stubbed. An unhandled resolver error travels through the GraphQL masker and the test reads the real request: POST /api/7/envelope/, X-Sentry-Auth with sentry_version=7 and the DSN public key, item header length in bytes, fingerprint equal to the recorded occurrence signature, stack frames oldest-first. The body contains no email address, no IP, no 64-char token, no DSN public key and no 'dsn' substring; redacted values arrive as [REDACTED]. Separate cases: page.error goes as a message event without a stack; HTTP 413 and an unreachable address keep the own history and log backend.error with adapter: sentry; DSN parsing including a path prefix and a rejection that does not repeat the value. Live run against GlitchTip 6.2.6 from the same compose profile: 4 occurrences became 2 groups of 2, the group hash 213883f740b19793b4ac782265976f91 equals md5 of our signature, tags carried stream/service/code/event/request_id/environment, transaction was graphql:feed, the issue title arrived as 'Error: live check: db failed for [REDACTED] from [REDACTED]', and no backend.error adapter failure was logged. CI run 36372217876 green on 7a18c9a.

server/tests/error-collector.test.ts ('is the default driver and the system works without an external service'): noop is chosen for an unset, empty and 'noop' ERROR_COLLECTOR_DRIVER and for NODE_ENV=production; an unknown driver still throws 'Unknown ERROR_COLLECTOR_DRIVER' (checked on 'glitchtip', since 'sentry' is now an accepted value); ERROR_COLLECTOR_DRIVER=sentry without ERROR_COLLECTOR_DSN throws 'ERROR_COLLECTOR_DSN is required'. The unhandled resolver error still reaches the own history with the INTERNAL_ERROR requestId and no failure log. CI run 36372217876 green on 7a18c9a.
